nodes.label: Strict Canonical Encoding Verification
nodes.rationale: Prevents malleability attacks by re-encoding decoded field and curve elements to verify they are in canonical minimal form.

nodes.label: Concrete Gate Satisfaction Checking
nodes.rationale: Evaluates emitted algebraic constraints over the concrete witness store to confirm completeness rather than universal circuit soundness.

nodes.label: Decoupled Constraint Emission on Failure
nodes.rationale: When witness computation errors occur, witness cells are frozen while constraint emission continues, guaranteeing full-circuit constraint output.

nodes.label: Unified Witness and Constraint Configuration
nodes.rationale: Combines witness execution and constraint synthesis into a single K rewrite rule so divergences between off-circuit and in-circuit semantics are immediately observable.

nodes.label: Test Preimage Generation Mode
nodes.rationale: Enables differential testing harnesses to record required public inputs, outputs, and commitments dynamically when transcripts run out.

nodes.label: Oracle 2: Constraint Checking
nodes.rationale: Verifies completeness by checking whether the witness satisfies in-circuit relations for emitted constraints (CLM-0716).

nodes.label: Differential Execution Harness
nodes.rationale: Compares status, register memory, public inputs, and skips between the K definition and the zkir-oracle Rust reference across the full program corpus.

nodes.label: ZKIR K Multi-Tiered Verification Layers
nodes.rationale: Employs three distinct verification layers (unit arithmetic checks, hash known-answer tests, and differential runs against Rust preprocess) to comprehensively validate executable K semantics.

nodes.label: CLM-0712 AST Preprocessing Strategy
nodes.rationale: Eliminates concrete syntax in K by reading JSON artifacts into Program terms via pyk.

nodes.label: Jubjub from_coordinates Parity Divergence (k01)
nodes.rationale: Rust preprocess uses only parity of x during Jubjub point decompression so (x+2, y) yields the correct point while violating exact coordinate gates.

nodes.label: Witness Computation and Circuit Constraint Dual Execution
nodes.norm_label: witness computation and circuit constraint dual execution
nodes.rationale: Synthesizes instruction-level circuit constraints in the same rewrite step as witness evaluation (per CLM-0704..CLM-0706), freezing witness on error while continuing constraint generation.

nodes.label: ZKIR-CURVES Module
nodes.rationale: Affine elliptic curve arithmetic across Jubjub, Curve25519, secp256k1, and secp256r1.

nodes.label: k-rust Frontend Compiler Performance Gap
nodes.rationale: k-rust failed to complete compiling the full ZKIR K definition within 25 minutes due to frontend pipeline bottlenecks, whereas canonical K completes in twenty seconds.

nodes.label: Chip Gating Underconstraint Modelling
nodes.rationale: Models the used_chips cell explicitly to avoid false synthesis errors or spurious constraint enforcement on uninitialised chips.

nodes.label: pyk JSON Preprocessor Ingestion
nodes.rationale: Uses a pyk preprocessor to transform JSON artifacts into KAST rather than in-K rewriting over large JSON ASTs, avoiding runtime fragility and overhead.

nodes.label: Build Preimage
nodes.rationale: Iteratively executes K semantics in generation mode to resolve dynamic transcript and communications commitment requirements until reaching a fixed point.

nodes.label: Diff Test Main Runner
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates differential testing between K formal semantics and Rust zkir-oracle across corpora with iterative preimage generation and input perturbation.

nodes.label: ZKIR Divergence Test Cases
nodes.rationale: Test case suite encoding specific findings from arc-zkir review and K semantics development.

nodes.label: Divergence Tests Main Runner
nodes.rationale: Executes regression tests covering known semantic divergences between off-circuit evaluation and in-circuit constraint synthesis.

nodes.label: ZKIR-CHECK Module
nodes.rationale: K entrypoint module for parsing and static well-formedness checking of ZKIR programs.

nodes.label: eval
nodes.rationale: Instruction-level constraint evaluator checking in-circuit relations against concrete witness values.

nodes.label: Outcome Sort
nodes.rationale: Four verification outcomes: holds, violated (unsatisfiable circuit), synthErr (unsupported dispatch or uninitialised chip), and unknown (missing witness).

nodes.label: usedChips
nodes.rationale: Determines active chips following IrSource::used_chips; explicitly does not initialise foreign chips on from_bytes32 (Finding 13).

nodes.label: ZKIR v3 Divergence Review
nodes.rationale: Catalog of behavioral discrepancies between off-circuit evaluation (witness generation) and in-circuit synthesis (Halo2 chip relations).

nodes.label: Oracle 1: Differential Testing
nodes.rationale: Testing methodology comparing K semantics against the Rust reference crate on version-3 programs to ensure equivalent off-circuit execution.

nodes.label: The ZKIR Semantics in K, as Built
nodes.norm_label: the zkir semantics in k, as built

nodes.label: Transcript Direct Indexing Panic Divergence (k02)
nodes.rationale: Rust crates slice transcripts directly causing out-of-range panics on short inputs, whereas K formal semantics returns a structured error.

nodes.label: Arbitrary-Precision Int Field Representation
nodes.rationale: Employs K Int with Euclidean modInt rather than MInt fixed-width types because field prime moduli do not fit powers of two.

nodes.label: Staged Target Surface Strategy
nodes.rationale: Targets the 34-instruction 13-type base surface of 92e8bdd3 with verified Agda spec before extending to 42 instructions via ZKIR-EXT.

nodes.label: fromCoordsGate
nodes.rationale: Checks exact on-curve and prime-order subgroup membership in-circuit, differing from off-circuit Jubjub parity decompression.

nodes.label: inSubgroup
nodes.rationale: Verifies prime-order subgroup membership; trivial for Weierstrass curves, requires order scalar multiplication for cofactor-8 Edwards curves.

nodes.label: jubjubFromXY
nodes.rationale: Off-circuit Jubjub point construction using only y and parity of x, causing divergence when x is non-canonical (Finding K1).

nodes.label: CLM-0711 Single Assignment
nodes.rationale: Enforces single assignment in static well-formedness so that identifiers cannot be redefined or overwritten, deviating from Rust preprocess behavior.

nodes.rationale: Cryptographic constants generated from midnight-circuits 7.2.4 for Poseidon hash and curve parameters.
